The problem is investment...people will not stick around for a show unless it catches their interest.  There is not a SNGLE fantasy series that has lasted more than two or three seasons in the last 10 years. The only real exception would be Game of Thrones...but even that is only in its third season.

Anybody catch Terry Goodkinds series TV show 'Legend of the Seeker'?  That show was a disaster when compared to the books and only lasted what a season and a half. 

Sadly...as much as I'd like to see WoT brought into a visual reality, I won't hedge my bets that it'll ever happen.
